title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.22362v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. translated_title: CoDA：数据引擎与动作策略的协同演化
translated_abstract: 生成式仿真可以实现机器人环境的自动化构建，但物理上有效的环境并不一定对训练有用。挑战在于如何识别能够针对策略失败之处的环境，以及能够帮助策略克服这些失败的监督信号。我们提出CoDA，这是一个仿真数据引擎与动作策略通过共享的异构记忆（记录环境构建、策略失败和学习进度）实现协同演化的框架。该记忆将来自视觉-语言评论家的经验证的诊断编译为重现难点的生成程序，以及帮助策略克服这些难点的训练程序。我们进一步提出Text2potential方法，将这些诊断转换为用于动作块价值学习的分阶段势函数，为策略更新提供密集监督，同时在标准塑形假设下保持任务的最优策略。测得的学习进度会指导后续的生成和程序编译。
tldr: CoDA通过共享异构记忆让仿真数据引擎与动作策略协同演化，并利用Text2potential将诊断结果转化为密集监督信号，自动生成针对策略弱点的训练环境以提升机器人策略学习效果。
en_tdlr: CoDA enables a simulation data engine and an action policy to co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory, with Text2potential converting validated diagnoses into staged potentials that provide dense supervision for policy learning.
